title: Fourier entropy versus total influence
status_explanation: Dated intake records an unsolved attempt. Primary literature through a September 2026 partial-result paper continues to formulate FEI as a conjecture. This does not certify absence of a subsequent solution or owner retirement.
exact_statement: There exists a finite universal C>0 such that for every integer d>=1 and every f:{-1,1}^d->{-1,1} under uniform measure, sum_{S subset [d]} hat(f)(S)^2 log_2(1/hat(f)(S)^2) <= C sum_{S subset [d]} |S| hat(f)(S)^2, with 0 log_2(1/0)=0.

definitions.hat(f)(S): 2^{-d} sum_x f(x) product_{i in S} x_i
definitions.I_i(f): P_uniform[f(x)!=f(x with coordinate i flipped)] = sum_{S containing i}hat(f)(S)^2
